messages:
maria-cs: FYI HelixCorp contacted support — says the contract promo from their PO never applied and they got billed for full amount. ticket ENC-4123. attaching the PO note they sent earlier. :grimacing:

sam-sales: can you paste the PO note and the invoice id? I want to confirm the promo code they quoted.

maria-cs: PO note (copied):
```
PO# 5567
Contract ID: HC-2026-Q1
Promo: CONTRACTUAL-HELIX-10K
Note: Apply one-time credit as per negotiated addendum.
```
Invoice id: INV-2026-789

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-789 created 2026-02-15 amount $12,345.00 status: posted

kevin-billing: looking. quick sanity check — our billing requires a matched promo token on the order metadata. if the PO note was free-text it might have never mapped to a promo record. sending queries. :eyes:

devon-support: steps to repro (internal):
```
# fetch invoice
redwood billing get-invoice --id INV-2026-789 --format json
# check promotions attached
jq '.promotions' invoice.json || echo "no promotions"
```

kevin-billing: ran the fetch, output shows `[]` for promotions and `notes` contains the PO text but no linked promo id. looks like the mapping step failed at ingestion.

sam-sales: was there supposed to be a ticket to ops to attach the promo tag? Sales submitted promo approval form, but I don't see the promo ID in the contract entry. assigning to me + finance to approve manual grant if needed. :thumbsup:

anya-accounts: I can approve a manual ledger adjustment but need: 1) justification text, 2) GL code, 3) approval from sales (sam). provide amounts and accounting memo.

maria-cs: justification: contract promo as negotiated during renewal for HC-2026-Q1; mismatch between PO free-text and billing ingestion prevented automated application. amount requested: $10,000 credit (per contract). customer currently seeing $2,345 due after partial application.

sam-sales: I authorize manual grant for $10,000 to reconcile per contract addendum. approving for accounting.

kevin-billing: will create manual credit entry in ledger. planned steps:
1) create internal adjustment ADJ-2026-155 linked to INV-2026-789
2) post credit memo for $10,000 with memo: "Contractual promo — HC-2026-Q1 — approved by sam-sales"
3) notify accounting and update customer invoice status
expect ~2 business days to appear in GL.

anya-accounts: GL code to use: 6201 — Sales Credits. please include the contract id and our internal approval chain in the memo. cc: accounting@redwood.com

kevin-billing: noted. I'll also add an audit note with the PO text and the support ticket reference. creating ADJ-2026-155 now. will post update when processed.

maria-cs: please ping me when it's posted so I can notify the customer and close ENC-4123. thanks.

devon-support: follow-up ops item: add a one-off ingestion alert when PO notes contain known promo keywords but no mapped promo id. small regex + rule should catch this class of failure and reduce manual grants. filing infra ticket INFRA-2048.

sam-sales: thanks everyone. once the ledger posts I'll confirm with HelixCorp and ask them to re-check billing UI. if they still see charges, we'll escalate to credit hold. :ok_hand:

billing-bot: ADJ-2026-155 created (pending posting). allocated to kevin-billing.

kevin-billing: posted ADJ-2026-155 — credit memo CM-2026-102 issued for $10,000, applied to INV-2026-789. accounting notified.

maria-cs: confirmed with customer — billing now shows credit applied, they’re happy. closing ENC-4123. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

devon-support: logged INFRA-2048 (ingestion alert), adding notes to runbook for CS to include promo ID in PO submission.

sam-sales: great. can we add a small checkbox to the sales close checklist to confirm promo token is captured? will save ops time.

anya-accounts: noted for next month’s process update.

kevin-billing: leaving audit note and marking thread resolved.

maria-cs: resolved — moving to archive.
